title: anthemis cretica subsp. columnae
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. columnae, commonly known as Columna's Chamomile, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is considered a subspecies of Anthemis cretica. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and calming properties, which can help alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis cretica subsp. columnae include its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as its use in treating menstrual cramps and other gynecological disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
